ai_ready.title: Is Your Website Visible to AI? Free AI Evaluation Call | Promonet
ai_ready.headline: Can AI actually find your business?
ai_ready.intro: More customers now ask AI assistants to recommend a local business. In a free 30-minute call, we’ll check whether AI bots can access and understand your website, then send you three clear next steps.
ai_ready.description: Free 30-minute AI evaluation call for UK small businesses. We check whether AI bots can access and understand your website, then email three clear next steps.
ai_ready.offerLabel: Free · 30 minutes · Real people · No obligation
ai_ready.imageAlt: Illustrative bike workshop owner checking her website on a laptop at her workbench
ai_ready.reelAlt: 35-second video: a customer asks an AI assistant for a local bike repair shop, a workshop owner checks her website, and Promonet explains the free AI evaluation call.
ai_ready.problemTitle: Customers are asking AI. Is your business in the answer?
ai_ready.problemBody: People increasingly ask AI assistants things like “recommend a good bike repair shop near me.” Those assistants rely on what they can read on the web. If AI bots can’t reach your pages, or your website doesn’t clearly say what you do and where, your business is easier to miss.
ai_ready.valueTitle: Small fixes now. Easier to find for years.
ai_ready.valueBody: Being AI-ready is mostly good website housekeeping: the right crawlers allowed in, content that machines and people can read, and a clear description of who you help. We help you prioritise the changes that matter, explained in plain English.
ai_ready.offerBody: We look at your website together on a video call and explain what AI bots can and can’t see. Afterwards, we email three prioritised next steps you can act on yourself, or with us.

benefits.title: Can AI access it?
benefits.body: We check crawler access, robots settings and whether your important pages can be reached at all.

benefits.title: Can AI understand it?
benefits.body: We look at readable content, page structure and the signals that help machines interpret your pages.

benefits.title: Is your business clear?
benefits.body: We check that who you help, what you do and where you work are stated plainly enough to be repeated accurately.

faqs.question: Is the evaluation really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. The 30-minute call and the email with three prioritised next steps are free, with no obligation to buy anything. If you’d like help making changes, we’ll agree a separate scope and quote first.

faqs.question: What do you mean by AI bots?
faqs.answer: AI assistants and AI search tools use automated crawlers to read public web pages. Some websites block them by accident, hide key information in images or scripts, or never clearly say what the business does. We check for those common problems.

faqs.question: Will you guarantee that AI recommends my business?
faqs.answer: No. Accessible pages and clear content can support discovery, but each AI service decides what to include. We don’t promise rankings, recommendations or a particular increase in traffic.

faqs.question: Do I need to prepare anything?
faqs.answer: Just your website address and a little context about your business and customers. We start with what’s publicly visible, so you don’t need to send passwords or technical documents.

ai_ready.narration: Are you AI-ready? More and more customers ask AI to recommend a local business. But can AI bots actually find your website, and understand what you do? We check what they can access, what they can understand, and how clearly your business comes across. We're Promonet. A small business, helping small businesses. Book a free thirty-minute AI evaluation call, and leave with three clear next steps. Real people. Plain English. No obligation.

connect_tools.title: Connect Your Business Tools — From £350 | Promonet
connect_tools.headline: Do your tools talk to each other?
connect_tools.intro: If you’re copying the same details from your inbox to a spreadsheet to your CRM, you’ve become the connection. We connect them, hands-on and directly with you, so the work flows on its own.
connect_tools.description: Stop retyping between tools. Promonet connects your inbox, spreadsheets and CRM with real, hands-on help. Simple connections from £350. Free 30-minute call.
connect_tools.imageAlt: Illustrative garden designer at a desk covered in sticky notes, copying details between his phone and laptop
connect_tools.reelAlt: 37-second video: a garden designer copies the same enquiry between tools, then a Promonet developer connects them, and the offer of simple connections from £350 is explained.
connect_tools.problemTitle: When your tools don’t talk, you become the connection.
connect_tools.problemBody: An enquiry arrives by email. You type it into a spreadsheet. Then into your CRM. Then you set a reminder. It’s the same information, again and again, and every retype is another chance for a typo or a missed follow-up.
connect_tools.valueTitle: Why so affordable? AI makes building software faster.
connect_tools.valueBody: We use AI tools to cut the time it takes to build and test an integration, and we pass that saving on. Experienced people still design, check and support everything we build, and you work directly with them.
connect_tools.offerTitle: Start with one connection that earns its place.
connect_tools.offerBody: Tell us which tools you use and what you’re copying. In a free 30-minute call, we’ll explore a useful first step, check feasibility and follow up with a fixed quote before you commit.

benefits.title: One useful workflow
benefits.body: A simple, one-way connection between two tools with suitable existing integration access.

benefits.title: Built, tested, explained
benefits.body: Setup, testing and a short handover so you understand what runs and how to use it.

benefits.title: A real person to help
benefits.body: Work directly with us, with 14 days of fixes for faults in the agreed workflow after handover.

faqs.question: What does “from £350” include?
faqs.answer: The starter covers one simple, one-way workflow between two tools with suitable existing integration access, setup, testing, a short handover and 14 days of fixes for faults in the agreed workflow. £350 is the minimum total charge for our work, including any applicable VAT. We confirm a fixed quote after checking feasibility.

faqs.question: Why is it cheaper than I expected?
faqs.answer: AI-assisted development means much less time spent on boilerplate code and testing, and we pass that saving on. The work is still designed, reviewed and supported by experienced people who have built CRM solutions for over 20 years.

faqs.question: Are there any other costs?
faqs.answer: Third-party subscriptions or usage charges are separate and will be identified before you commit. Migrations, complex custom systems, additional features and ongoing monitoring are quoted separately.

faqs.question: Can you connect any two tools?
faqs.answer: We first check the tools’ APIs, permissions and other integration options. Some products or subscription plans limit what is possible. We’ll explain those limits before quoting, rather than promise a connection we haven’t checked.

faqs.question: Will it pay for itself?
faqs.answer: It depends on how much time the task takes today, what that time is worth to you and any recurring costs. We’ll talk it through honestly on the call. Recovered time creates capacity; it doesn’t automatically create cash savings.

connect_tools.narration: Do your tools talk to each other? Or are you copying the same details from your inbox, to a spreadsheet, to your CRM, again and again? When your tools don't talk, you become the connection. We connect them, so the work flows on its own. Real humans, hands-on, working directly with you. And because AI makes building software faster, simple connections start from three hundred and fifty pounds. Book your free thirty-minute call.
